definitions: A prominent Vietnamese Confucian scholar, statesman, poet, and military strategist during the early Lê Dynasty of Vietnam.
A national hero of Vietnam, known for his contributions to the Lam Sơn uprising against the Ming occupation.
examples: Nguyễn Trãi was a key advisor to Emperor Lê Lợi.
The works of Nguyễn Trãi are still studied today.
